# YerlitAS Labs

> Independent studio making relaxing puzzle games and practical everyday apps for Android. Contact: yerlitaslabs@gmail.com

## Games

- [Tessera: The Light Weaver](https://yerlitaslabs.github.io/tessera/): a calm light and mirror logic puzzle for Android. Turn mirrors, split beams and fuse colors until every socket glows; each solved board becomes a stained-glass window. 1,000 machine-verified levels in ten tiers, a Sky Atlas of 100 constellations (each a live wallpaper), no timer, no lives, no in-app purchases. Free with occasional short ads between screens and optional rewarded videos; no banners. English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish. Android 8.0+. Coming soon to Google Play.
- Tessera in other languages: [Türkçe](https://yerlitaslabs.github.io/tessera/tr/), [Deutsch](https://yerlitaslabs.github.io/tessera/de/), [Français](https://yerlitaslabs.github.io/tessera/fr/), [Español](https://yerlitaslabs.github.io/tessera/es/).
- [Minela: Block Puzzle](https://yerlitaslabs.github.io/minela/): a relaxing mosaic block puzzle game for Android. Drag blocks onto an 8×8 board, clear rows and columns, chain combos up to MINELA and wipe the whole board. 5,000 Adventure levels in 250 chapters named after famous mosaic sites (Zeugma, Ephesus, Isfahan, Kyoto…), a Daily Puzzle with streaks and monthly trophies, and an endless Classic mode with a Google Play Games leaderboard. 7 boosters, special Bomb, Lightning and Prism tiles, 25 medals, 40 achievements, cloud save. Free, nothing to buy; occasional short ads between games and optional rewarded videos, no banners. Plays online (up to 15 minutes offline a day). English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish. Android 8.0+. On Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.audio.minela

## Apps

- [BarcodeVault](https://yerlitaslabs.github.io/barcodevault/): an inventory app and barcode scanner for Android, made for stock counts (stocktaking) in shops, warehouses, stockrooms, offices (IT asset tracking with serial numbers) and home collections. Scan 22 barcode types with the camera (QR Code, Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 128, Code 39, ITF, GS1 DataBar and more), count quantities with per-count duplicate rules (add to quantity, reject and warn, or separate row), add locations and notes, then export to Excel (.xlsx), CSV or a printable PDF report. Also reads barcodes from photos and PDF files, creates QR codes and barcodes (PNG, JPG, PDF, SVG), prints A4 label sheets, searches across all counts and compares a count with an expected stock list (Excel or CSV). Works offline, no account; data stays on the device, with optional AES-256 encrypted backups. Free and ad-supported, no subscription: new counts, image scanning, code creation and the tools open for 1 hour after a short video; continuing a count, exporting and backups are always free. English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish. Android 8.0+. On Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.audio.barcodevault
- BarcodeVault in other languages: [Türkçe](https://yerlitaslabs.github.io/barcodevault/tr/), [Deutsch](https://yerlitaslabs.github.io/barcodevault/de/), [Français](https://yerlitaslabs.github.io/barcodevault/fr/), [Español](https://yerlitaslabs.github.io/barcodevault/es/).
